lines.beaver: 토요일이 민지 생일이에요. 파티 준비 같이 해요!
lines.beaver_en: Saturday is Minji's birthday. Let's prepare the party together!
lines.beaver_roman: Toyoiri minji saengirieyo. Pati junbi gachi haeyo!
lines.en: Okay. I'll buy the birthday gift.

lines.beaver_en: What would be a good gift?
lines.learner: 민지가 책을 좋아해요. 유명한 책을 살게요.
lines.en: Minji likes books. I'll buy a famous book.
lines.roman: Minjiga chaegeul joahaeyo. Yumyeonghan chaegeul salkkeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. How do we invite our friends?
lines.en: I'll send the friends an invitation text.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. The party is at my place.
lines.en: Good. What time does the party start?

lines.beaver: 저녁 여섯 시예요. 친구들에게도 알려 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Six in the evening. Please tell the friends too.
lines.beaver_roman: Jeonyeok yeoseot siyeyo. Chingudeuregedo allyeo juseyo.
lines.en: Sure, I'll let them know the time too.

lines.beaver: 케이크는 제가 살게요. 얼마나 큰 걸 살까요?
lines.beaver_en: I'll buy the cake. How big should it be?
lines.beaver_roman: Keikeuneun jega salkkeyo. Eolmana keun geol salkkayo?
lines.learner: 오는 친구가 적어요. 작은 케이크도 괜찮아요.
lines.en: Not many friends are coming. A small cake is fine.
lines.roman: Oneun chinguga jeogeoyo. Jageun keikeudo gwaenchanayo.

lines.beaver_en: By the way, your grandma's birthday is next week too, right?
lines.en: Yes, next week is my grandma's birthday.

lines.beaver_en: Did you buy a gift for her too?
lines.en: Not yet. I'll buy flowers this weekend.

lines.beaver: 민지는 파티를 몰라요. 꼭 비밀로 해 주세요!
lines.beaver_en: Minji doesn't know about the party. Please keep it a secret!
lines.beaver_roman: Minjineun patireul mollayo. Kkok bimillo hae juseyo!
lines.en: Got it. I won't tell Minji.

lines.beaver: 민지가 문을 열고 들어오면 같이 축하해요!
lines.beaver_en: When Minji opens the door and comes in, let's celebrate together!
lines.beaver_roman: Minjiga muneul yeolgo deureoomyeon gachi chukahaeyo!
lines.learner: 좋아요. 큰 소리로 축하할게요. 토요일에 봐요!
lines.en: Okay. I'll cheer loudly. See you Saturday!
lines.roman: Joayo. Keun soriro chukahalkkeyo. Toyoire bwayo!
